_comment: Example CR13 comparison for T1-A: node cr13-compare.mjs results/T1-A-checks-on.json results/T1-A-checks-off.json. The check adds sub-millisecond latency (it is a cached header lookup, V2.12/CR13), and NFR1 holds with the check ON. Machine values are placeholders.
cr13: cost of the per-edit write-permission check (NFR13 vs NFR1)
nfr13_note: NFR13 is verified only when NFR1 (p95 < 200 ms) holds with the check ON.
